create_SGDScheduleFreeReference_optimize: create a Schedule-Free SGD optimizer with configurable learning rate, momentum, and weight decay
run_SGDScheduleFreeReference_step: run a single optimization step with optional closure for loss computation
switch_to_eval_mode: switch the optimizer to eval mode to use the averaged model parameters for evaluation
switch_to_train_mode: switch the optimizer back to train mode to resume training with the correct state
configure_warmup_steps: configure linear learning rate warmup with warmup_steps and weight_lr_power parameters
